coauthors.name: G. Veena (Veena Dileep)
coauthors.affiliation: Amrita School of Computing, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri, India
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Faculty co-author on both NATYA-AI (IEEE Access 2025) and the INDIACom 2025 mudra paper. Her wider record (Semantic Scholar author 2271948116) is Indic-language NLP and knowledge graphs: 'Comprehensive Integration of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Fine-Tuned Large Language Models for Malayalam News Categorization' (2025), 'Named Entity Recognition for Telugu and Kannada on Naamapadam Dataset' (2025), 'Semi-Supervised Bootstrapped Syntax-Semantics-Based Approach for Agriculture Relation Extraction' (2023). That is low-resource / multilingual Indic NLP and task performance, not research on cultural values, cross-cultural difference, cultural bias or value alignment in LLMs. FALSE under the strict gate. (Her S2 profile is also name-merged with unrelated medical and agronomy papers, so it is not a clean signal.)
